prompt:
Table 1: Total turnover estimates, standard error and relative standard error for education and water and waste management, UK, 2016 Total turnover in | Standard error in | Relative standard error (or coefficient of variation)2 ---|---|--£ millions1 | £ millions2 Industry 1: Education (private provision only) | 42,649 | 526.8 | 0.01 (or 1%) Industry 2: Water supply; sewerage, waste management and remediation activities | 34,677 | 222.7 | 0.01 (or 1%)

What is the reference period or as-of date on total turnover of private-provision education in the UK in 2016, in £ millions (Annual Business Survey)?
response_text:
**Reference period: calendar year 2016** — the £42,649 million is a full-year flow, not a point-in-time stock, so it has no single as-of date.

Details from the table and source:

- **Figure**: £42,649m total turnover, Industry 1 — Education, private provision only (SIC 2007 Section P, ABS-covered non-public parts).
- **Period type**: annual aggregate. Turnover accumulates over the 12 months of 2016; an "as-of date" doesn't apply the way it would to employment or stock levels.
- **Survey**: Annual Business Survey (ONS), 2016 reference year. ABS collects returns on the business's own accounting year and asks respondents to report for the period nearest the calendar year; ONS treats the result as calendar-year 2016.
- **Precision**: standard error £526.8m, RSE 1%, so a roughly ±£1.0bn 95% interval (~£41.6bn–£43.7bn).

One caveat worth carrying: the ABS 2016 figure as published in this table is whichever vintage the source document used — ABS results are revised (provisional → revised → final), so if you need to reconcile against a current ONS release, the number may have moved slightly even though the reference period has not.
